paras: Chamaeleo necasi, also known commmonly as Necas's chameleon or Necas' chameleon, is a species of lizard in the family Chamaeleonidae. The species is native to West Africa.
The specific name, necasi, is in honor of Czech herpetologist Petr Nečas.
Chamaeleo necasi is found in Benin and Togo.
The preferred natural habitat of Chamaeleo necasi is forest, at elevations up to 500 m (1,600 ft).
